_note: Sound effects (plan.md 5.23). Each sound: file = a WAV in assets/audio/sfx/ (made by tools/sfx/sound_studio.html), bus = UI (taps, windows, confirmations) or Alerts (important events and warnings); both feed the SFX bus, so the Sound switch in Settings silences them. volume_db = louder (+) or quieter (-) than the file. pitch_jitter = random pitch change each time (0.02 = up to 2% up or down), so repeated sounds don't sound identical. min_gap = seconds before the same sound may play again (a burst of sales is one sound). when = what plays it (for humans). Sounds whose 'when' says 'not used yet' are ready for systems the game doesn't have yet.

toggle.when: Choice buttons (chips), check boxes and switches.

panel_open.when: A window or the Build menu opens.

panel_close.when: A window or the Build menu closes.

select.when: A building is tapped and its action bar appears.

road.when: A road is built or removed.

place.when: A building is placed or moved, or an upgrade starts.

collect.when: Goods are collected, put on a shelf or taken off one.

sale.when: Goods sell: to the Trading Post, or shelves selling out.

purchase.when: Goods are bought at the Trading Post.

warning.when: A warning: warehouse full, no road, not enough workers, people leaving.

critical.when: Buildings lose power for lack of electricity, or cash drops below zero.

tax_change.when: The sales tax rate changes (another bracket).

large_profit.when: Not used yet: an unusually strong day of earnings.

major_investment.when: Not used yet: a big project is funded.

trade_agreement.when: Not used yet: a trade deal is signed.

growth.when: Not used yet: the economy starts growing.

surplus.when: Not used yet: a product piling up beyond demand.

shortage.when: Not used yet: shops run out of something people want.

recession.when: Not used yet: earnings falling for days.

bankruptcy.when: Not used yet: the village can't pay its bills.
